## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include local CI and an explicit QA step appropriate to the change. Explain skipped or unavailable checks and remaining risks. For documentation-only changes, check links and the final diff; explain why runtime tests do not apply.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Tests or evaluations cover changed behavior and relevant failure cases, or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Relevant security, reliability, accessibility, and performance effects were checked or marked not applicable above.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change and distinguishes proposals from implemented behavior.
- [ ] Source authority and claimed/committed/observed/verified evidence states are preserved.
- [ ] The diff and fixtures contain no credentials, private runtime data, or unrelated changes.
- [ ] Commits include a `Signed-off-by` line for the Developer Certificate of Origin.
